title: You reported it.
Who follows up?
technical: A report is only the beginning.
voice: Reporting a problem shouldn't mean chasing it forever.

title: An office of
autonomous agents.
voice: Pramanik is an accountability office run by autonomous voice agents.

title: Many reports.
One shared case.
voice: Related complaints share one case. Agents bring together resident reports, evidence, and the conversations that came before.

title: Every conversation
becomes context.
technical: Persisted history → the next call brief
voice: Before the next call, the agent recalls the earlier promise and builds a brief with specific questions.

title: Specialists investigate.
A coordinator plans.
voice: Three specialists review reports, history, and responsibility in parallel. A coordinator combines their findings into an action plan.

dialogue.speaker: Samantha (English (US))
dialogue.text: Yesterday you promised a new seal. Has the repair started?

dialogue.speaker: Rishi
dialogue.text: The seal has arrived. We'll complete the repair tomorrow afternoon.

title: The call ends.
The work continues.
voice: Tool calls save the exact commitment. A deadline becomes a persistent review job, processed by a worker after the conversation ends.

title: A claim needs
a ground check.
voice: Residents check the repair with observations and photos. AI supports human review. Conflicting evidence keeps the case open.

title: Pramanik
voice: Pramanik. Every promise tracked. Every outcome open to scrutiny. Built by Yash.
